statement: For a finite prior p on a family E with alpha*sigma <= rho_x <= beta*sigma, an exactly sigma-preserving marginal T with sup_x ||T(rho_x)-rho_x||_1 <= r obeys 0 <= chi_p(E)-chi_p(T(E)) <= log(beta/alpha)*r. If a symmetric full-domain broadcaster B has both marginals T, then I(X:C|B) and I(X:B|C) are each at most log(beta/alpha)*r.
assumptions: faithful reference sigma included in the sandwich
T is CPTP, preserves sigma, and preserves the sandwich
B is a full-domain CPTP symmetric two-output channel with marginal T
novelty_boundary: The continuity calculation is also in the supplied N92/N93 record. The new handoff is the explicit two-way CMI formulation for every finite prior. It is not an EB reconstruction theorem.
costs: No dimension or prior-support factor; finite exact channel representation and prior are mathematical inputs.
falsifier: A finite-dimensional exact arithmetic example satisfying the sandwich and channel hypotheses with either CMI exceeding log(beta/alpha)*r.
next_gate: Prove or refute a dimension-free conversion from small two-way CMI of channel-origin symmetric extensions to small common-measurement Bayes variance under bounded Holevo capacity.

statement: A dimension-free modulus g_C(delta)->0 converting two-way small conditional mutual information for channel-origin symmetric broadcast extensions with Holevo capacity <=C into common-measurement Bayes variance q(E,p)<=g_C(delta) would imply uniform EB reconstruction by the N92 minimax identity.
assumptions: all finite priors satisfy the same capacity bound C
the extension comes from a full-domain CPTP channel, has equal receiver marginals, and is not an abstract extension only
the CMI-to-q modulus is uniform in dimension and prior support
novelty_boundary: Fawzi-Renner gives a quantum recovery map, not a measurement. Small CMI does not generally imply proximity to an exact Markov state. The narrower channel-origin, equal-marginal, bounded-Holevo statement remains unverified.
costs: Must charge all receiver registers, channel acquisition, and any measurement/decoder representation; no hidden input-dependent side information is permitted.
falsifier: A bounded-capacity sequence with full-domain symmetric broadcasters, both CMI tending to zero, and Bayes variance bounded below by a positive constant.
next_gate: Derive a predictive-measurement theorem from a K-receiver symmetric extension, or construct the stated falsifier.

statement: The N61 dyadic pure-copy ladder has b2<=1/L and EB error tending to one for d=L*2^(L-1), but its Haar-prior Holevo information grows at least Omega(2^L log L/L); it is not a bounded-capacity counterexample.
assumptions: the finite design reproduces the sector Haar averages
novelty_boundary: N61/N67 are internal source-derived results; the capacity formula is an analytic entropy calculation from their stated family. Large Hilbert spaces and designs were not materialized by supplied diagnostics; correctness and priority remain externally unreviewed.
costs: Hilbert dimension sum_j binomial(2^j+d-1,2^j); exact design acquisition/cardinality grows and is not efficient; all sectors and flags count as physical dimension.
falsifier: A uniform upper bound on chi for this same Haar/moment-design family, contradicting the entropy lower bound.
next_gate: Continue seeking a genuinely bounded-capacity extension or a proof that capacity blocks N61-like receiver ladders.

statement: For the N92 instrument-derived compatible map Phi=C* C with C=(L+Psi)/2, the canonical measurement-and-prepare channel Psi satisfies I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi), yielding half-trace EB error <= (1/2)*sqrt(2*theta*r) on bounded likelihoods with residual r.
assumptions: supplied bistochastic Kraus family K_y with both normalization sums equal I
reference sigma central in the block algebra
novelty_boundary: This is a supplied N92 internal proof, not an independent proof here. It does not represent every positive selfadjoint self-compatible map as an instrument-derived C*C.
costs: Kraus family, POVM effects, reference block structure and finite precision are supplied; no general instrument search or efficient decoder compiler is proved.
falsifier: A direct counterexample to the SOS identity or an explicit map in the stated class violating the EB residual bound.
